note: Media Thumbnails Video contributes a MediaThumbnail plugin (id media_thumbnail_video, mime video/mp4, class MediaThumbnailVideo) to the media_thumbnails framework; createThumbnail() uses php-ffmpeg + GD to write a PNG frame as the video media entity thumbnail. Config object media_thumbnails_video.settings has ffmpeg, ffprobe (binary paths, nullable), timeout ('3600'), threads ('12'); settings form at /admin/config/media/media-thumbnails-video-settings. Also adds field formatter file_video_extended ('Video extended') that sets the thumbnail as the <video> poster. No permissions/Drush/plugin-types. Because real thumbnailing needs FFmpeg binaries + a real mp4 the agent won't have, ALL evals are grounded in the module's own config (paths/threads) — no thumbnail is actually generated.

evals.prompt: How does the media_thumbnails_video module generate thumbnails for videos, which framework does it plug into, and which video MIME type does its plugin handle?
evals.expected_output: It provides a MediaThumbnail plugin (id media_thumbnail_video) to the Media Thumbnails framework; the plugin declares mime video/mp4 and uses the php-ffmpeg library + GD to extract a frame and save it as the video media entity's thumbnail.

evals.prompt: Where do I configure media_thumbnails_video, and which settings can I set (config object media_thumbnails_video.settings)?
evals.expected_output: Configure it at /admin/config/media/media-thumbnails-video-settings (route media_thumbnails_video.media_thumbnails_video_settings), writing media_thumbnails_video.settings: ffmpeg and ffprobe binary paths (empty = auto-detect), timeout (default 3600) and threads (default 12).

evals.prompt: Besides generating thumbnails, media_thumbnails_video adds a field formatter for video files. What is its id/label and what does it do with the generated thumbnail?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'Video extended' formatter (id file_video_extended) for file fields, extending core's File Video formatter to render an HTML5 <video> tag with the generated thumbnail set as the poster attribute.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, media_thumbnails_video has been configured with an explicit FFmpeg binary path and a custom thread count. Inspect the live configuration and report the ffmpeg path and the number of threads it is set to use.
evals.expected_output: media_thumbnails_video.settings has ffmpeg = '/opt/introspect/bin/ffmpeg' and threads = '4' (ffprobe = '/opt/introspect/bin/ffprobe'). Discoverable via `drush cget media_thumbnails_video.settings`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, media_thumbnails_video has an explicit FFprobe binary path configured. Inspect the live configuration and report the ffprobe path it is set to use.
evals.expected_output: media_thumbnails_video.settings has ffprobe = '/opt/introspect/bin/ffprobe'. Discoverable via `drush cget media_thumbnails_video.settings ffprobe`.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, configure media_thumbnails_video to use the FFmpeg binary at /usr/bin/ffmpeg and the FFprobe binary at /usr/bin/ffprobe, and set it to use 6 threads. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: media_thumbnails_video.settings has ffmpeg = '/usr/bin/ffmpeg', ffprobe = '/usr/bin/ffprobe' and threads = '6' (e.g. set via the settings form or config factory).

evals.prompt: My video previews aren't generating because Drupal can't find the video tool. On my server the tools live at /usr/bin/ffmpeg and /usr/bin/ffprobe. Please point the video thumbnail module at those, and have it use 6 worker threads. Save it live.
evals.expected_output: Same end state as the expert phrasing: media_thumbnails_video.settings ffmpeg = '/usr/bin/ffmpeg', ffprobe = '/usr/bin/ffprobe', threads = '6'.
